questions.question: Six friends, Gopi, Sheela, Ravali, Sarayu, Hina and Giri, are standing in a row, facing to the north. There are two persons between Sheela and Hina. Ravali is between Hina and Sarayu. Only one person is standing ahead of Gopi. Giri is between Gopi and Hina. Hina is third from the back of the row. Which two persons are standing between Sheela and Hina?
questions.solution:
**Explanation** **:**

 
• **Number of persons - 6 i.e Gopi, Sheela, Ravali, Sarayu, Hina and Giri**
 
• **They are standing in a row facing to the north.**

**​**1) Hina is third from the back of the row 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb8f90487113b837f550a748efa42a33f8484e7847e4ad255972df04e0186a50.png] 

2) There are two persons between Sheela and Hina

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d4d7375ba403f00aeaafa6c7a7c4173c22f6656df9a837027b4ead98812bd1d.png] 

3) Only one person is standing ahead of Gopi 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f1bf99df92ada06595e2a470803df4b3a79b6009c1f6cf1282df8a3447ee7e9.png] 

4) Giri is between Gopi and Hina.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/066425a8377a5b1cf9130223fbbe5f4a8a809c6a6d491e1c8835ea450066c0fb.png] 

5) Ravali is between Hina and Sarayu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c86bb7fc260fa99cb11c42f2195f033d307fffe3286615cbfeefa2120730cf5.png] 

Thus , from the final arrangement Gopi and Giri are the two persons who are standing between Sheela and Hina.

Hence, **"Gopi and Giri"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: 'Resistance' is related to 'Ohm' in the same way as 'Force' is related to '______________'.
questions.solution:

Similarly,

Hence, '**Newton**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: Six friends are sitting in a row facing north. Mehar is sitting at the west end. Nidhi is sitting to the left of only Sia. Two persons are sitting between Ansh and Nidhi. One person is sitting between Gaurav and Mehar. Rakshit is sitting towards the right of Ansh. Who is sitting at the third place from the east?
questions.solution:
**Explanation :**

 
• **Number of person = 6 **
 
• **They are sitting in a row facing north.**

**​**1) Mehar is sitting at the west end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38c1acc37a742642731453f6ce5d2fda497a53097ce572b1a2d6c99cc91081d2.png] 

2) One person is sitting between Gaurav and Mehar. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43deb4b4c820461705b737f575a592c329e725840677a473459474b05c644233.png] 

3) Nidhi is sitting to the left of only Sia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43deb4b4c820461705b737f575a592c329e725840677a473459474b05c644233.png] 

4) Two persons are sitting between Ansh and Nidhi - After positioning Ansh there is only position left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e Rakshit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e0785deeaa9d4fb7701c8de3ebe8043c4ea577193e615675a77fd69f5067db4.png] 

5) Rakshit is sitting towards the right of Ansh - This condition is automatically fulfilled according to the previous condition.

Thus, according to the final arrangement Rakshit is sitting at the third place from the east end.

Hence, **"Rakshit"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:
Some spoons are plates.
Some plates are tumblers.

Conclusions:
I. No tumbler is a spoon.
II. No plate is a spoon.
III. Some tumblers are spoons.

options.text: Either conclusion I or conclusion III follows
Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e6b8f69742ad23ca433bbb860d6506c98779597b18d75a53c69c890983d3d46.png] 

**Conclusions:**
I. No tumbler is a spoon. → Do not follow (As, there is no definite relation between tumbler and spoon, hence false)
II. No plate is a spoon. → Do not follow (As, Some spoons are plates)
III. Some tumblers are spoons. → Do not follow (As, there is no definite relation between tumbler and spoon, hence false)

Conclusion I and III are complementary to each other, so either conclusion I or III is true.

Hence, **Either conclusion I or conclusion III follows**.
